messages:
marta: Quick q — who is authorized to flip the emergency toggle for the payments rollout? Need to escalate now. Also what's the minimum audit evidence we should attach (ticket, PR link, screenshots)?

devin: If it's urgent follow the runbook: oncall + eng-sre + product lead. Technical permission sits with the 'release-ops' IAM group. infra-admins can also flip in exceptional cases.

oncall-bot: runbook reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kill-switch — use `/flip-toggle <flag> <off|on> --reason "..."` (this posts an audit entry).

aseem: For context: the flag is `payments_v2_live`. If we must flip, prefer scoped canary (region: us-east-1) unless we see widespread failures. Recommend TTL 30m and automatic rollback if error rate drops < baseline. Require post-mortem for any manual flip.

linda: I want ticket + PR link + one screenshot of the anomaly dashboard + @product signoff in the ticket before flipping if possible. I'll add a quick template to the runbook.

devin: One more ops detail: save the toggle-service response as evidence. Example payload/command below — that output is stored in the audit log and should be attached to the incident ticket:

```
curl -X POST https://toggle.redwood/api/flip \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REPLACED' \
  -d '{"flag":"payments_v2_live","state":"off","by":"marta","reason":"high latency spike"}'
```

This returns a JSON audit object with id/timestamp.

marta: Thanks — can someone with perms run a dry-run in staging so I can confirm I have the right fields?

ops-runbook-bot: Dry-run OK for marta in staging. Logs will be forwarded to #ops-audit.

aseem: I'll be on call for the flip window. If release-ops isn't online, eng-oncall can flip and then hand over to release-ops when they come back; document handover in the incident ticket (who flipped, time, reason).

linda: Done — added checklist items and a short evidence capture snippet to the runbook. Posting PR in ~10m.

devin: tagging @sam-security for visibility on KMS/key usage when toggles touch encrypted config.

sam-security: noted. Ensure KMS audit trail is enabled for `redwood-prod-toggle-key`. We'll need the key audit logs attached to the incident for root-cause work.

marta: Ack. I'm opening the ticket now and will link the PR + staging dry-run output here shortly.

devin: :thumbsup:
